title: Power Grid appoints Venkata Subrahmanayam Vallurie as CFO just now Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd announced the appointment of Venkata Subrahmanayam Vallurie as Chief Financial Officer effective July 1, 2026, following the superannuation of Ravisankar Ganesan on June 30, 2026. The Board approved the appointment on June 10, 2026. Vallurie brings over 35 years of experience, including 32 years within the company, specializing in finance functions and digitization

Zydus Wellness appoints Dr. Shyam Ramakrishnan as Chief Scientific Officer just now Zydus Wellness Limited has appointed Dr. Shyam Ramakrishnan as Chief Scientific Officer effective July 1, 2026, based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Dr. Ramakrishnan joins on a full-time contract with over 25 years of experience in translational science, clinical research, and innovation platform development. Goodricke Group reports profit rise despite revenue dip in FY26 just now Goodricke Group Limited reported a net profit of ₹255.52 million for FY26, a rise from ₹200.58 million in the previous year, even as revenue from operations fell to ₹8,012.90 million due to adverse weather impacting tea yields. The company’s instant tea business achieved record export volumes, while the branded tea division improved profitability.
